output.summary: KEP-1177 proposed a kubeadm feature letting users customize control-plane and etcd static pod manifests (e.g., add sidecars, change probe timeouts) using Kustomize. Its status is replaced, and the readme says it was superseded by the KEP tracked in #1739, which uses raw patches instead.
output.rationale: Kubeadm's component configuration only exposes a limited set of cluster-wide args, so users had to hand-edit static pod manifests after init/join. This KEP aimed to give node-level control over generated static pod manifests. The readme states the KEP was replaced by #1739, which chose raw patches for customization instead of Kustomize.
output.outcome_reason: The readme says the KEP was replaced by the KEP tracked in #1739 which uses raw patches for customization. The sources do not give a detailed reason for choosing raw patches over Kustomize.

alternatives.why_not: Replaced by the KEP tracked in #1739, which uses raw patches for customization. The sources do not say why the change was made.

alternatives.option: Extending the kubeadm component configuration (extraArgs and similar fields)
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the component configuration covers only a limited set of cluster-wide args, and the KEP explicitly does not aim to deprecate it. It cannot add sidecars or alter probe timeouts.
